How to plan your whole week
in 20 minutes
Pick one fixed moment. Sunday evening or Monday morning, same time every week. A ritual is easier to keep than a vague intention.
Write your three big wins for the week. Not twenty tasks, just three results that would make the week a success if nothing else got done.
Block time for them in your calendar. A goal without a time slot is just a wish. Put the hard things in the mornings when your energy is high.
Plan your workouts and meals. Training days and a rough food plan remove dozens of small decisions during the week.
Before: my weeks just happened to me. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and planning my days feels calm and clear.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: my weeks just happened to me. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Planning my days feels calm and clear.

slides.texte_overlay: Leave empty space. Not every hour needs a plan. Free time absorbs surprises and keeps the week from falling apart.
Review last week first. What worked, what didn't, what you'll change. Two minutes of honest review makes every new week better.
